summary: Tested the Elenco Iscritti (archivio-iscritti) module end to end. Backend: 16/16 pytest pass, covering activation and 403 when inactive, marketplace listing, editions including a 2019 one and 409 on a duplicate, imports from a semicolon CSV with English headers, a comma CSV with Italian headers, and an XLSX with other English headers. Auto-suggested mapping, manual remapping and ignored columns all work, and a new custom field is stored in custom. Re-import dedup works, a cross-edition import gives 2 participations, the consent rules hold (si -> true with source, no or missing -> false), the error report and saved templates work, and import file chunks are deleted after the import. Also passed: combined filters, sort and pagination, KPI, CSV/XLSX export, manual CRUD with 409 on a duplicate, consent_history, anonymize and delete, member read-only (403 on write/export/import/editions), tenant isolation (404), Brevo returning non_configurato, the SA orgs/sync/force-sync endpoints with audit entries, and the press recipients count (consented iscritti only). Frontend at desktop 1920 and mobile 390: sidebar entry right after Anagrafiche only when the module is active; inactive org sees the iscritti-inactive page; all page buttons, filters, sorting, column toggles, KPI, the full 5-step wizard, detail dialog with participation and consent history, Edizioni tab, imports history, Brevo sync toast, CSV download and manual add work. Member UI is read-only. Marketplace shows the active service first with mkt-open-iscritti, and the SA iscritti-admin-table renders. 2 functional bugs found: (1) press SendDialog confirm button is disabled when only iscritti recipients exist; (2) manual add does not set last_year.

minor.issue: A participation added manually does not update iscritti.last_year (only the import path sets it). Effects: the 'Ultimo anno' column shows '—', sorting by last_year is wrong, and the daily retention cron filters on last_year < limit, so these people are never auto-anonymized. Seen in the DB: ui.manuale person had last_year None after being added with a 2026 edition.

By design, anyone whose latest participation is more than 5 years old is anonymized on the next daily run. An admin who imports a historical edition (e.g. 2019, which the UI encourages) will lose those people the next day. Consider a warning in the wizard or applying retention only to records older than N days.

Turning consent on for a person who unsubscribed via the link sets unsubscribed=false. An admin can therefore re-subscribe an unsubscribed person; only the Brevo-side listUnsubscribed check prevents the re-sync. The UI also pre-fills consenso_fonte with the old source, so the new history entry reuses e.g. 'Importazione file «f1.csv»' instead of 'Modifica manuale'.
Imports abandoned after the preview stay in status 'analizzato'. They show up in the imports history and as 'Ultima importazione · analizzato' in the SA table.

ui_bugs.issue: press-send-confirm is disabled by !rc?.count and its label uses rc.count only. With 0 press contacts and 3 consented iscritti, the dialog shows 'Destinatari idonei: 3 (di cui 3 iscritti)' but the button reads 'Conferma invio a 0 destinatari' and is disabled. The backend /send accepts press + iscritti. Fix: use rc.count + (rc.iscritti||0) for both the disabled check and the label.

issues: Brevo status line repeats the text: 'Brevo: Brevo non configurato · date · Brevo non configurato' (status label plus error).
Brevo column shows raw codes (escluso_consenso, da_sincronizzare); map them to readable Italian labels.
The fields have placeholders but no visible labels, so once filled you can't tell them apart (e.g. '333', 'ASD Pisa').
Data di nascita is a plain text input; use a shadcn date picker or a masked input.

After creating an edition only the label/gare are reset. Clicking '+ Crea edizione' again creates a second edition with an empty label for the same year instead of being blocked (UI allowed creating '2018 ' with an empty label).

action_items: PressEditor SendDialog: enable confirm and fix the label when rc.count + rc.iscritti > 0 (currently disabled with iscritti only)
_add_part (manual add/edit participation): update iscritti.last_year like the import does
Decide retention behaviour for freshly imported historical editions (>5 years old get anonymized at the next cron run); at least warn in the wizard
Optional: do not reset 'unsubscribed' via an admin edit (or require an explicit confirm), and use 'Modifica manuale' as the source when consent is toggled
Optional UX: readable Brevo status labels, labelled fields in IscrittoDialog, deduplicated Brevo status text, hide/clean abandoned 'analizzato' imports
critical_code_review_comments: iscritti.py is 938 lines (above the 700 guideline); split into import/brevo/sa submodules
kpi(): aggregates per_person over all of the org's participations (to_list(200000)) on every call; compute recurring with a $match on the selected ids instead
parse_row line 169: `_date(...) or part.pop(...) and None` is obscure; make it explicit
list_iscritti: the `dir` query param shadows the builtin; harmless but confusing

success_rate.backend: 100% (16/16 pytest); 1 minor logic bug found via a DB check (last_year)

seed_data_creation: Pytest creates 2 orgs (test_iscrA_/test_iscrB_<ts>) plus a direct-DB member (role user) and deletes everything by org_id in teardown (all collections except audit_logs). UI tests used the existing TEST_ISCR Org plus a temporary inactive org, a member and a press release. All of these were cleaned up: the TEST_ISCR Org is back to 3 iscritti / 2 editions with press deactivated. The pre-existing TEST_ISCR Org (owner in /tmp/iscr_email) was NOT deleted because it was not created by this agent; main agent should delete it if no longer needed. Audit log entries were left untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend/tests && python -m pytest test_iscritti_module.py -v -n 0 (sequential, shared state). The non-admin member is inserted directly in the DB with membership role 'user'; can_edit is false. Press recipients test inserts a press_releases doc directly (releases are normally only created via AI generate). Cookie banner: cookie-reject-all. Login testids: email-input, password-input, submit-auth-button. Mobile nav: mobile-menu-button and then the last sidebar-link-iscritti.
rca of the issue: SendDialog: PressEditor.jsx line ~98 uses `!rc?.count` and `rc.count` in the button label, ignoring rc.iscritti, while the backend schedule() sums press + iscritti. last_year: iscritti.py _add_part upserts the participation but never runs the `last_year` $set that _run_import does (lines 509-511).
